_about: Copy for the Havas Play internship work. Read by scripts/import-havas.mjs (writes data/projects.json) and by app/work/havas-play/page.tsx (intro, order). youtubeIds maps a manifest video number (n) to a YouTube id once the film is uploaded; the import then turns the pending placeholder into the YouTube facade. Slugs and order are fixed here; titles are display names.

hub.title: Havas Play
hub.subtitle: Internship · Editor & Art Director · Paris · January to June 2026
hub.shortDescription: Internship at Havas Play, Paris: editing, art direction and some filming for sports and entertainment brands.
hub.intro: Havas Play is the sports and entertainment agency of Havas, based in Paris. Between January and June 2026, Remi worked there as an editor and art director, with some filming for a few clients. The clients below are Allianz, BKT, the Fédération Française de Judo, Kellogg's, KFC, Nissan, Orange, Paris FC, Renault, Sanofi and Louis Burton, plus work made for the agency itself.
